up: Retrieve the compounds reported in document CHEMBL5729258. For each compound, return its ChEMBL identifier (molecule_chembl_id) and its preferred name (compound_name) from the molecule_dictionary table. To associate compounds with the document, join the docs table (filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5729258') with compound_records via doc_id, then join molecule_dictionary via molregno. Include all compounds regardless of whether they have activity data; do not filter on document type, confidence score, or any other attributes.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS compound_name
FROM docs d
INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5729258';
